candidates.change_summary: Return the negation of the stored _paused flag instead of the flag itself.
Return the constant true instead of the stored _paused flag.
Return the constant false instead of the stored _paused flag.
Change the checked interface id from IERC165 to IAccessControl, so IERC165's interfaceId is no longer claimed as supported.
Remove the IAccessControl check so only the base ERC165 interfaceId is reported as supported.
Remove the delegation to super, so only IAccessControl's interfaceId is supported and IERC165's is not.
Return true for every interfaceId instead of checking specific interfaces.
Return false for every interfaceId instead of supporting IAccessControl and IERC165.
Return the negation of the stored role membership.
Swap the role and account indices when reading the role mapping.
Return true unconditionally instead of the stored membership flag.
Return the constant DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE instead of the stored admin role for the given role.
